book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Yecho abhola bhabholwa bhake kunyopa Chapanga

Lichiko limo Yecho akibha pakiyepela anyopita Chapanga. Pajhomolila kujhopa, mmolwa gwake jhumo ajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, mutubhole na twenga kunnyopa Chapanga ngita Yohane chabholita bhabholwa bhake.”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Piminnyopa Chapanga, nnongila naha,

content.text: Mutupele chakulyegha chito cha kila lichiko.

content: Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake, “Kwa nnandanikiho, pakate jhino jwajhenda ku nyumba jha nkoche mundo, uhiko gwa kilo na kunnobholela, ‘Makalongo bhango, chonde unyahike ipande ya mabumunda itato,
nhwalo nkoche gwango abhetukile pakajha kuhumii ku mwanja gwake na nenga ngwete jhe kilebhe chakunabhuya.’
Nkoche gwino jwabhii nkate jhola nganyangwii, ‘Chonde ungotoka kung'aha! Nindite nnyango gwango. Nenga na yana yango tugholwike nijhimuka ndeka kumpekeya kilebhe chochoha chela!’

Ninnobholela chakaka, nikitopotola ndeka kujhimuka kumpela chakulyegha nhwalo mwenga mwakoche bhake, nambo paligha najhimuka na kumpela kilebhe chinyopita kwa nhwalo mukibha jhe na hone jha kujhendelela kunnyopa.”
“Ninnobholela, nnyope na mangota napelwa, mupalahe mipata, nkong'onde litangala na mangota nadindulilwa.
Nhwalo gwenio mundo jhojhoha jwajhopa upelwa, na mundo jhojhoha jwapalaha napata, na mundo jhojhoha jwakong'onda litangala nadindulilwa.
Tate ghane pakate jhino jwampekeya mwana mundo lijhoka kone anyopite luhomba?
Bho, anda anyopite lihombe, ma tate mundo namupela kipyelele?

Pamonga na kukokotoka kwino mangota, mimanya kwapela yana hino yambone, chakaka Tate gwino jwa kunane kwa Chapanga natenda kuchocha kwa peniya, bho, Tate gwino jwa kunane napelangana ndeka Uhuke gwa Chapanga kwa bhoha bhibhannyopa?”
Yecho na Belechebule

Lichiko limo Yecho pabhengita nchuka jhughuntenda mundo jhumo jwateile abhehe jwangalongela. Bhahe, nchuka ghola puchomwika, mundo jhola pahotwila kulonge, dola lilongo lya bhando lijhakuhechuka hake.
Nambo bhando bhange bhalongila, “Jwenio atenda naha kwa likakala lya Belezebule, nkolongwa jwa michuka.”
Bhando bhange bhapata bhanyighe Yecho, bhajhakunyopa abhalangiye nginyililo anda likakala lihumii kunane kwa Chapanga.

Bhahe, Yecho akamanyite chibhahola, ajhakwalobholela, “Unahota nkolongwa ghoghoha ghola anda upechengine gwenie kwa gwenie na kubhehe ibhogha ibhogha gwihoto ndeka kujhema, na bhando bha nyumba jhimo anda bhapechengine nabhakikomelekeya.”
Limbembela anda libhii na ibhogha ibhogha ikomana yenio kwa yenio, Unahota gwake nahujhema bho? Ninnobholela naha nhwalo mangota mwinnobholela nenga nibhenga michuka kwa likakala lya Belezebule.
Anda nenga nibhenga nchuka kwa likakala lya Belezebule, bho, bhabholwa bhino bhabhenga kwa uhotolo gwa ghane? Bhando bhino mabhene nabhahadabula mangota.
Nambo anda nibhenga nchuka kwa likakala lya Chapanga, ngohe Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga uhikite kwino.
“Mundo jwabhii na likakala, pailonda nyumba jhake kwa nkoha, ilebhe yake yoha ibhehe teeke.
Nambo mundo jhonge jhuna likakala kupeta jwenio nahotola kuntyala, na kumpoka chilaha yake yaihobholela na kupechengana ilebhe yampokite.”
“Mundo jhojhoha jwangalongohana na nenga, jwenio angana nenga, mundo jhojhoha jhola jwangalundika pamonga na nenga, atenda kupechengana.”
Kubhujha kwa nchuka kwa mundo
“Nchuka anda abhengitwe kwa mundo, ityangatyanga kunjenga kujhomo ipalaha pa kupomolela anda apakolihi jhe.
Mikilobholela, ‘Nangelebhuka kajha jhango kuhumila.’ Nambo piibhujha na kukolela ndopo, ipyaghilwe na kukilimwa mbone,
peniya, ujhenda kwatola michuka bhange chaba, bhina likakala kupeta jwenio. Na bhene uhika na kutama na mundo jwenio. Na ughome gwa mundo jwenio ubhehe jwanganandela hake kuliku chakibha makacho.”
Kuhangana kwa uchakaka
Yecho palongila naha, mwikeghe jhumo kuhumii pakate jha lilongo lya bhando lela, ajhakunonoha lilobhe kwa Yecho, “Ahanganilwe mwikeghe jwampapite na jwanyongiche!”
Nambo Yecho ajhakujhanguu, “Bhahanganilwe bhoha bhibhajhoha lilobhe lya Chapanga na kulikamula!”
Bhando bhapala nginyililo
Lilongo lya bhando pulijhonjikika, Yecho pajhendelila kulongolela, “Kibheleko eche ndi kikokotwike, kipala nginyililo. Nambo nakipelwa ndeka nginyililo jhojhoha kupeta jhela jha Yona.
Nhwalo Yona akibha nginyililo kwa bhando bhu ku Ninabhe, na helahela Mwana gwa Mundo nabhaha nginyililo kwa kibheleko chenje.

Kwa lichiko lya kilongoche mwikeghe, jwahumile ku Cheba, najhema na kwahadabula bhando bha kibheleko chenje bhalemwite, nhwalo jwenio ahumila kutale na kujhenda kujhokanikiya malobhe gha malango gha nkolongwa Selemane, na pamba abhii munahota nkolongwa kupeta Chelemane.

Bhando bha ku Ninabhe nabhajhema mulichiko lya luhadabulo, na bhene nabhalongela kibheleko chenje kibhii na ulemwa. Nhwalo bhando bha ku Ninabhe bhakaulekite uhakaho pubhajhohina ghighatangichwa na Yona, na kubhehe peniya abhii nkolongwa kupeta Yona!”
Lumule lwa yegha
“Abhii jhe mundo jwapamba kolobohi na kuhiya hilu kugubikila kibhegha. Nambo kolobohi anda ipambwitwe ubheka panane jha kinala, bhando pubhajhingii nkate bhalola mbone.
Liho lino ndi kolobohi jha yegha jhino. Anda liho lino lyambone, yegha jhino jhibhii mululanga. Nambo liho lino anda litochwike, helahela yegha jhino jhoha ibhii mulubhendo.
Chakaka mukilolekeye mbone, kolobohi ibhii nkate jhino ikotoka kubhehe mulubhendo.
Peniya ndi, anda yegha jhino jhoha ibhii mululanga, na lubhii jhe lubhendo, yegha jhoha naing'anyima ngita pulumulikila mabhene lumule lwake.”
Yecho abhatakalila Mapwalichayo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo
Yecho pajhomolila kulonge gheniya, Pwalichayo jhumo ajhakunnalika Yecho ajhende kajhake akalye. Ndi Yecho ajhakujhingii nkate, na kutama pahe kulyegha.
Pwalichayo jhola ajhakukangacha hake, pamonita Yecho ilyegha changakuha mache.
Peniya Bhambo ajhakunnobholela, “Mangota maka Mapwalichayo, mijhoha kibaba na libechene kwa panja, nambo kwa nkate mwino mutwelii lukwatulo na ukokotoko.
Mangota mwenga kupumbumuka! Bho, jwabhombite ilebhe kwa panja jhojho ndeka jwabhombite na nkate?
Nambo mwapekiye akahocho ilebhe ya nkate jha miojho, na henge yoha naibhaha yambone kwino palonge jha Chapanga.

“Nanola choto mangota Mapwalichayo! Kongo majhopa bhando chaka jha ndimbilo na mandebhele na mahamba ghange gha makolo. Nambo muleka kwatendela bhando ghambone palonge jha Chapanga. Ntumbula kubhehe bhambone changaleka na ghange.
“Nanola choto mangota maka Mapwalichayo! Nhwalo mipala kutama mighoda ya palonge munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude na kujhambuchwa na bhando kwa makilikite pa maghuliho.
Nanola choto mangota, kwa nhwalo muwanana na mambe ihitwe, na bhando bhatyanga panane jhake changamanya.”
Mubhola jhumo jwa Malaghalikilo ajhakunnobholela, “Mmola, pumulongela naha helahela mutuligha na twenga.”

Yecho ajhakunyangula, “Helahela bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo nanola choto! Nhwalo mwagheghecha bhando mihigho mitopaho, na kone ighegheka ndeka. Mabhene mihoto ndeka kujhinula kwa lukonje lumo kwatangatila.
Nanola choto mangota! Muchenga mambe ya milondole bha Chapanga, bhibhakomitwe na akahoko bhino.
Nambo mabhene mighawene na kujheketela mahengo ghubhatehila akatate bhino, bhene bhakomite milondole bha Chapanga, na mangota michengelela mambe yabhe.
Nhwalo malango gha Chapanga ghilongela naha, ‘Nanatuma kwino milondole na akatenga, bhange nabhakomwa na bhange nabhabha mu lung'ahe.’
Ndi tela na bhando bha kibheleko chenje, nabhabha mulung'ahe kwa nhwalo gwa miyahe jha milondole bhoha jhijhitike kuhumii mu kupanganwa kwa nnema,
na kutumbulila pakomitwe Abele ade Zakaliya, jwakakomitwe pakate jha kachangwale na chehemo jha nyahinyahi. Chakaka, ninobholela, kibheleko chenje naking'ahichwa nhwalo gwa kukoma!
“Nanola choto mangota akabhola bha Malaghalikilo! Kwa nhwalo muhuhite upungulo gwa litangala lya kukibholela. Mangota mabhene mujhingii ndeka, na mahibhilikiye bhando bhibhapala kujhingila!”
Yecho pabhokita kwenio, Mapwalichayo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhala bhajhakutumbula kuchobhelela na kunkonya machwale ghamahele,
bhanyonje kwa kilebhe chochoha chalongela.
